body: B1 fix: clear Messages<DebugDamage> on OnExit(GameState::Wasted); weapon damage applied directly to Health inside the Playing-gated fire system (no queued damage message). Rejected: a unified Damage message + state check at read time (the leaked message is read in the first Playing fixed tick, so a read-time state check cannot catch it).

Head hitbox: child Sensor sphere (layer Hitbox, filters NONE) that encloses the capsule above ~1.42 m, single closest-hit ray. Rejected: head sphere inside the capsule (probe: capsule always hit first, headshots impossible) and a second head-only ray per body hit.
Weapon visuals are primitives (pickup boxes, held box); Kenney Blaster Kit 2.1 (CC0, 40 files) not fetched. Alternative named for the owner in Open questions.

Placeholder gunshot = custom bevy_audio Decodable noise burst (no new crate). Rejected: bevy/wav feature (pulls hound, not in the offline cache) and Kenney audio pack (manifest + fetch for a T13 placeholder).

Shooting range (dummies + weapon/ammo pickups) spawns only in the City world at CityLandmarks.park_center; TestArea gets none so client character gate (one CharacterModel) and fixed test geometry stay intact. Rejected: range near PlayerSpawn (no sidewalk direction exposed without a citygen/golden-hash change).

Floating damage numbers: UI Text node positioned each frame via Camera::world_to_viewport (bevy_camera 0.19.1 camera.rs:579), pop via UiTransform.scale; rejected world-space billboard because Bevy 0.19.1 has no 3D text (Text2d is 2D-camera only) and would need a new crate or texture pipeline.

Exact-damage gates (75/50/20 and runtime Health==75) replaced by bands derived from roll_damage(base,variance,u=0..1) plus health-drop == DamageDealt.damage; rejected zero-variance fixture root because it would test a config the game never ships.

D14 head sabotage uses head_radius 0.15, not the plan's 0.2: with head_height 1.6 a 0.2 sphere touches the capsule top exactly (1.6+0.2 = 1.8), f32 gives 1.8000001 > 1.8 and validation passes; 0.15 is strictly inside. Validation rule kept as planned.

D12 waits until bloom is back to 0 between shots (recovery_delay + per_shot/recovery_rate, derived from weapons.ron) instead of the plan's run_ticks(20): with 20 ticks the pistol bloom stays 1 deg and shot 2 missed the dummy (trace hit the floor at z 5.2).

Muzzle flash and tracer meshes get NotShadowCaster: the first runtime capture showed the tracer only as its shadow line on the grass. Alternative kept out: a pool or a custom unlit-no-shadow material.

t6.py SMG burst aims at the third (full-health) dummy instead of the middle one: the middle dummy had ~22 HP left after the pistol shots and died after two SMG hits, so the burst screenshots had no hit marker. Alternative: wait 3 s for the dummy reset.
Back-to-back brp_extras/screenshot calls (second issued as soon as the first PNG appeared) failed with 'A screenshot capture is already in progress'; fixed by 0.15 s spacing.

Aim framing fixed in data only: camera.ron aim_shoulder_offset 0.55->1.0, aim_distance 2.0->2.6 (0.9/2.4 tried first, head right edge ~90 px from the crosshair; 1.0/2.6 gives ~110 px). Rejected: fading/hiding the player model when close (needs alpha materials on the Kenney model, more code for the same result).

Tracer readability: juice.ron tracer width 0.02->0.05 m, seconds 0.06->0.1 (>= SMG fire_interval 0.08, so a burst always shows one). The real cause of the invisible tracer was the muzzle end projecting inside the player's head silhouette; the wider aim shoulder fixes the occlusion. Rejected: brighter/emissive material or a code change to the tracer mesh.

t6.py review item 3: added a liveness check (burst screenshots bracketed by BRP counts of Name("Tracer") entities, at least one capture must have tracers alive on both sides) instead of an image/pixel gate; look of framing and tracer stays owner/owner-proxy by eye. Flip-RED: tracer.seconds 0.001 -> AssertionError (0/0 tracers).

Held gun: parented to the model's arm-right joint (found by Name after the glTF instance spawns) with render.ron hand_offset/yaw/pitch, scale 1/model_scale to undo the joint's model scale. Root cause of the invisible gun: body-local muzzle_offset (0.25,0.35,-0.275) lies inside the Kenney head mesh (x +-0.61, y 0.92..1.80, z +-0.46 m). Rejected: a fixed body-local offset (does not follow the holding/shoot clips).

Arm layer: AnimationGraph node masks are shared by every player of the graph, so per-character arm masking cannot toggle node masks. Graph holds locomotion twice (mask 0 for unarmed, mask ARMS for armed) plus hold/shoot clips masked to BODY; mask groups assigned from the spawned AnimationTargetIds by joint Name at model ready. Rejected: mutating node masks at runtime (would arm the dummies too).

Normal camera shoulder_offset 0.45->0.8 so the right hand and gun show beside the Kenney head from behind (and the normal-view crosshair is no longer covered, cf. body_hit.png). Rejected: leaving it (gun hidden end-on behind the 1.2 m wide head).

Verdict NEEDS_FIXES on a Wasted->Playing input leak: a fire latch raised during Wasted (write_action_intent has no state gate, cursor stays captured) fires one shot on the first Playing tick after respawn (headless 12->11, BRP 12->11). Alternative rejected: SHIP-PENDING-RUNTIME with the bug as a note, because it is the same cross-state leak class as B1 that this task was asked to close and the fix plus gate is small.

B1 ghost shot: reset the player's ActionIntent to default on OnExit(Wasted) in gta_sim (flow/wasted.rs drop_queued_input) instead of gating write_action_intent to Playing: the sim reset is gated headlessly and covers any intent writer (client, BRP, future AI); StateTransition runs before RunFixedMainLoop, so the first Playing tick sees clean latches.

L1: cooldown, bloom and a recovery countdown (recovery_wait) live in GunSlot and tick for every gun, held or not; since_shot dropped for a countdown so an untouched slot stays at its default (death_wasted_respawn_at_hospital compares guns before/after). Alternative rejected: parallel [f32;3] arrays on Loadout.

L2: DamageDealt gains `shot` (per-pull counter, Local<u32> in fire_weapons); the client merges messages by (shooter, shot, target) into one label with the summed damage. Alternative rejected: merge per frame by (shooter, target), which fuses two SMG shots when a frame spans two fire intervals.

L4: CombatPlugin { seed } takes the city seed from WorldSource::City; TestArea keeps seed 0 so headless gates stay deterministic. Alternative rejected: reading Res<CitySeed> at runtime (absent in TestArea).

QA round 2 runtime Wasted probe presses LMB + Digit4 + KeyR once mid-Wasted instead of clicking in a loop until Playing: a loop races the state flip and a click that lands in Playing fires legitimately, making the result ambiguous. Last-frame latches are covered headlessly (latches_raised_every_wasted_frame_are_dropped).
